name: spinner-forever
description: On the customer dashboard, the list of projects never loads — there's just a 'Loading…' spinner that spins forever and an empty page. Customers can't see any of their projects. Fix it so the data shows up.
bugs: app.js fetches from a stale hardcoded URL (http://localhost:3001/api/items) that nothing serves, so the request fails, the catch swallows it, the spinner never hides, and no items render; the data is actually served at ./data/items.json on the same origin
correct_diagnosis: app.js fetched a stale dev API URL (http://localhost:3001/api/items) that nothing serves, so the request failed and the spinner never cleared; pointing the fetch at the data served on the same origin (./data/items.json) loads the projects.

reference_fix.description: Fetch the data from the path served on the same origin.
